title: BidDecline
description: A settler's report that it will not bid on a request. The internal shape, carrying the reason code the settler chose plus its own free-text detail. Projected to the caller-facing shape through the decline catalog, which is the single source of truth for the reason set.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable decline reason in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, from apis/decline/v1/catalog.json. A code absent from the catalog projects to OTHER rather than being rejected, so a settler on a newer catalog is never a parse failure.

message.description: Settler-authored detail naming the specific cause. Never relayed to the caller, because it is text this gateway neither authors nor validates.

payment_id.description: The payment this decline answers. Absent on the quote flow, which carries quote_request_id instead.

quote_request_id.description: The quote request this decline answers. Absent on the payment flow, which carries payment_id instead.
